examples.zh: 实验室排除了克隆那棵古橡树的想法。

meaning: phr. 解释,说明;占(一定比例)

examples.en: Imports from Asia account for 40% of total sales.
examples.zh: 来自亚洲的进口占总销售额的 40%。

examples.en: The whole debate boils down to one question of cost.
examples.zh: 整场争论归结起来就是成本问题。

meaning: phr. 扩展业务,开辟新领域

examples.en: After years of selling books, the shop branched out into gifts.
examples.zh: 卖了多年书之后,这家店扩展到了礼品业务。

meaning: phr. 温习,重温(知识技能)

examples.en: I need to brush up on my Spanish before the trip.
examples.zh: 出行前我需要温习一下西班牙语。

examples.en: Small bookstores are bucking the trend of closing down.
examples.zh: 小书店正在逆势而为,没有跟着倒闭。

examples.en: Commuters had to contend with delays of over an hour.
examples.zh: 通勤者不得不应对超过一小时的延误。

examples.en: One bank cut its fees and the others quickly followed suit.
examples.zh: 一家银行降低手续费后,其他银行纷纷效仿。

meaning: phr. 获得进展;赢得支持

examples.en: Electric vehicles are gaining ground in rural areas.
examples.zh: 电动汽车正在农村地区赢得市场。

examples.en: During the strike, many families went without hot meals.
examples.zh: 罢工期间,许多家庭没有热饭也只好将就。

meaning: phr. 敲定,反复谈判达成

examples.en: Union leaders spent weeks hammering out a new pay deal.
examples.zh: 工会领导花了数周谈判敲定新的工资协议。

meaning: phr. 坚持要求,非……不答应

examples.en: She rejected the first offer and held out for a better price.
examples.zh: 她拒绝了第一个报价,坚持要更好的价格。

examples.en: Regular exercise helps keep illness at bay.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼有助于抵御疾病。

examples.en: The old factory was knocked down to make room for flats.
examples.zh: 老厂房被拆除,为公寓腾出空间。

examples.en: The columnist lashed out at the new censorship rules.
examples.zh: 专栏作家猛烈抨击新的审查规定。

meaning: phr. 勉强应付,将就使用

examples.en: We made do with instant noodles when the stove broke.
examples.zh: 炉子坏了,我们只好凑合吃泡面。

examples.en: The loan merely papers over the company's deeper troubles.
examples.zh: 这笔贷款只是掩盖了公司更深层的麻烦。

examples.en: The teacher picked up on signs of stress in her students.
examples.zh: 老师察觉到了学生身上的压力迹象。

examples.en: Officials tried to play down the severity of the leak.
examples.zh: 官员们试图淡化泄漏的严重性。

meaning: phr. 费力读完;艰难穿过

examples.en: I plowed through a four-hundred-page report last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我啃完了一份四百页的报告。

meaning: phr. 强烈要求,竭力争取

examples.en: Parents are pressing for smaller class sizes.
examples.zh: 家长们强烈要求缩小班级规模。

examples.en: The firm cut costs to ride out the recession.
examples.zh: 公司削减成本以安然渡过衰退。

examples.en: His apology did not ring true to most listeners.
examples.zh: 在大多数听众听来,他的道歉并不真诚。

meaning: phr. 抓住(话语或机会)大做文章

examples.en: Critics seized on the minister's careless remark.
examples.zh: 批评者抓住部长的失言大做文章。

examples.en: The government injected cash to shore up the bank.
examples.zh: 政府注入资金以支撑这家银行。

examples.en: The champion simply shrugged off the criticism.
examples.zh: 这位冠军对批评毫不在意。

examples.en: Investors are still sizing up the new market rules.
examples.zh: 投资者仍在评估新的市场规则。

meaning: phr. 把(决定)留到第二天再定

examples.en: Don't answer now—sleep on it and call me tomorrow.
examples.zh: 现在先别回答——考虑一晚,明天再打给我。

examples.en: His version of events does not square with the records.
examples.zh: 他对事件的说法与记录不符。

examples.en: The coating stands up to years of heavy rain.
examples.zh: 这种涂层经得起多年暴雨的考验。

examples.en: City leaders admitted they had not thought the plan through.
examples.zh: 市政领导承认没有把计划考虑周全。

examples.en: The test results bear out her theory about memory.
examples.zh: 测试结果证实了她关于记忆的理论。

examples.en: The memo cast light on why the project was cancelled.
examples.zh: 这份备忘录阐明了项目被取消的原因。

examples.en: The committee acted on the auditor's recommendations.
examples.zh: 委员会根据审计师的建议采取了行动。

examples.en: The airline is banking on a strong summer season.
examples.zh: 这家航空公司指望一个红火的夏季旺季。

examples.en: The hospital beefed up its emergency staffing overnight.
examples.zh: 医院连夜加强了急诊人手。

examples.en: Thick fog blotted out the mountain peaks.
examples.zh: 浓雾遮住了群峰。

meaning: phr. 收支相抵,不赚不赔

examples.en: The restaurant finally broke even in its third year.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅终于在第三年实现收支平衡。

examples.en: Nobody thought the launch could be brought off on time.
examples.zh: 没人认为发布能按时完成,结果做到了。

examples.en: Management brushed aside the safety complaints.
examples.zh: 管理层对安全投诉置之不理。

examples.en: The studio bumped up her salary after the hit film.
examples.zh: 电影走红后,公司提高了她的片酬。

meaning: phr. 相信,接受(观点);认购

examples.en: Investors have bought into the promise of green hydrogen.
examples.zh: 投资者已相信绿氢的前景。

meaning: phr. 开创,打拼出(地位/事业)

examples.en: She carved out a career in investigative journalism.
examples.zh: 她在调查新闻领域开创了自己的事业。

meaning: phr. 从中牟利,趁势赚钱

examples.en: Brands rushed to cash in on the viral trend.
examples.zh: 各品牌蜂拥而至,想从这股热潮中牟利。

examples.en: Old conventions were cast aside during the reform.
examples.zh: 改革期间,旧惯例被纷纷抛弃。

examples.en: The new study casts doubt on earlier findings.
examples.zh: 这项新研究使人们开始怀疑早先的结论。

meaning: phr. 记下,取得;把……归因于

examples.en: The team chalked up its fifth straight victory.
examples.zh: 球队取得了五连胜。

examples.en: The studio churns out two romance films a year.
examples.zh: 这家工作室每年粗制滥造两部爱情片。

examples.en: The city is clamping down on illegal parking.
examples.zh: 该市正在严打违章停车。

examples.en: Regulators vowed to crack down on false advertising.
examples.zh: 监管机构誓言严厉打击虚假广告。

examples.en: His lack of French counted against him in the interview.
examples.zh: 他不会法语,这在面试中成了劣势。

examples.en: Software bugs kept cropping up before the release.
examples.zh: 发布前软件漏洞不断冒出来。

examples.en: The gallery deals in contemporary Scandinavian art.
examples.zh: 这家画廊经营当代斯堪的纳维亚艺术。

examples.en: Volunteers doled out hot soup to the runners.
examples.zh: 志愿者向跑步者发放热汤。

examples.en: Rising rents are eating into household savings.
examples.zh: 不断上涨的房租正在侵蚀家庭积蓄。

examples.en: After graduation, he embarked on a teaching career.
examples.zh: 毕业后,他开始了教学生涯。

examples.en: The firm must face up to its declining sales.
examples.zh: 公司必须正视销售额下滑的现实。

examples.en: The goalkeeper fended off two close-range shots.
examples.zh: 守门员挡出了两次近距离射门。

examples.en: She fought off a cold before the final exams.
examples.zh: 她在期末考试前硬是扛住了一场感冒。

meaning: phr. 正式申请(破产、离婚等)

examples.en: The retailer filed for bankruptcy in October.
examples.zh: 这家零售商于十月申请破产。

meaning: phr. 坚持完成,贯彻到底

examples.en: Good planners follow through on every commitment.
examples.zh: 优秀的计划者会把每项承诺贯彻到底。

examples.en: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise for her art career.
examples.zh: 失去那份工作反而成就了她的艺术事业。

examples.en: The cottage is a stone's throw from the beach.
examples.zh: 小屋离海滩只有几步之遥。

term: at the drop of a hat

examples.en: He would help you at the drop of a hat.
examples.zh: 他会毫不犹豫地帮你。

meaning: phr. 回到原点,从头再来

examples.en: The funding fell through, so we are back to square one.
examples.zh: 资金落空,我们又回到了原点。

meaning: phr. 找错对象,搞错方向

examples.en: If you think I leaked the memo, you are barking up the wrong tree.
examples.zh: 如果你以为泄露备忘录的是我,那你就找错人了。

examples.en: Stop beating around the bush and tell me the price.
examples.zh: 别拐弯抹角了,直接告诉我价格。

examples.en: We had to bite the bullet and replace the whole roof.
examples.zh: 我们只好咬紧牙关把整个屋顶换掉。

meaning: phr. 熬夜用功,挑灯夜战

examples.en: She burned the midnight oil before the bar exam.
examples.zh: 司法考试前她天天熬夜苦读。

examples.en: After four hours of rehearsal, the band called it a day.
examples.zh: 排练了四个小时后,乐队决定收工。

examples.en: The scandal cast a shadow over the awards ceremony.
examples.zh: 丑闻给颁奖典礼蒙上了阴影。

meaning: phr. 到紧要关头,濒临爆发

examples.en: The dispute over pay finally came to a head.
examples.zh: 工资之争最终到了摊牌的地步。

examples.en: Do not cut corners on safety checks.
examples.zh: 安全检查绝不能偷工减料。

examples.en: Let me cut to the chase: we need more time.
examples.zh: 我直说了吧:我们需要更多时间。

meaning: phr. 一无所获,想不起来

examples.en: Police drew a blank in their door-to-door search.
examples.zh: 警方挨家挨户搜查却一无所获。

examples.en: I lend money to friends, but I draw the line at signing loans.
examples.zh: 我可以借钱给朋友,但给贷款做担保是我的底线。

meaning: phr. 承认说错话,收回前言

examples.en: If I am wrong, I will gladly eat my words.
examples.zh: 如果我错了,我甘愿认错。

examples.en: Many startups fall by the wayside within two years.
examples.zh: 许多初创公司撑不过两年就倒下了。

meaning: phr. 白费力气,徒劳之举

examples.en: Pushing this plan now is flogging a dead horse.
examples.zh: 现在力推这个方案纯属白费力气。

examples.en: He got cold feet the day before the wedding.
examples.zh: 婚礼前一天他突然打起了退堂鼓。

examples.en: The project never got off the ground for lack of funds.
examples.zh: 由于缺乏资金,项目始终没能启动。

examples.en: Let me get the ball rolling with a quick warm-up quiz.
examples.zh: 我先来个小测验热场。

examples.en: Reporters got wind of the merger before it was announced.
examples.zh: 记者们在合并公布前就听到了风声。

examples.en: The council gave the green light to the new bridge.
examples.zh: 市政会批准了新桥项目。

meaning: phr. 加倍努力,多做一些

examples.en: Our guides always go the extra mile for guests.
examples.zh: 我们的导游总是为客人多想一步。

meaning: phr. 抓救命稻草,急不择路

examples.en: Suing the reviewers is just grasping at straws.
examples.zh: 起诉这些评论者不过是病急乱投医。

term: hit the nail on the head
meaning: phr. 一针见血,说得恰到好处

examples.en: Your review hit the nail on the head about the pacing.
examples.zh: 你关于节奏的评论一针见血。

meaning: phr. 一上任就全力展开

examples.en: The new coach hit the ground running with double sessions.
examples.zh: 新教练一上任就安排了双倍训练量。

examples.en: His argument about tax savings does not hold water.
examples.zh: 他关于省税的论点根本站不住脚。

examples.en: In a nutshell, the plan costs too much and delivers too little.
examples.zh: 简而言之,这个计划成本高、成效小。

examples.en: The manager is in hot water over his leaked emails.
examples.zh: 经理因邮件外泄而陷入麻烦。

examples.en: Brands jumped on the bandwagon after the challenge went viral.
examples.zh: 挑战走红后,各品牌纷纷跟风。

examples.en: Police struggled to keep a lid on the protests.
examples.zh: 警方难以控制住抗议活动。

term: kill two birds with one stone
meaning: phr. 一石二鸟,一举两得

examples.en: Cycling to work kills two birds with one stone: exercise and savings.
examples.zh: 骑车上班一举两得:既锻炼又省钱。

meaning: phr. 千方百计,想尽办法

examples.en: Detectives left no stone unturned in the search.
examples.zh: 侦探们在搜查中想尽了一切办法。

term: let the cat out of the bag
phonetic: /let ðə kæt aʊt əv ðə bæɡ/

examples.en: Marty let the cat out of the bag about the surprise party.
examples.zh: 马蒂说漏了嘴,泄露了惊喜派对的事。

examples.en: The team lets its hair down at the annual dinner.
examples.zh: 团队在年会上尽情放松。

term: light at the end of the tunnel
phonetic: /laɪt æt ði end əv ðə ˈtʌnl/

examples.en: With vaccines rolling out, there is light at the end of the tunnel.
examples.zh: 随着疫苗铺开,曙光就在眼前。

term: like a fish out of water
meaning: phr. 如鱼离水,格格不入

examples.en: On my first day abroad I felt like a fish out of water.
examples.zh: 刚到国外的头几天,我浑身不自在。

examples.en: The patient is responding well but is not out of the woods yet.
examples.zh: 病人恢复不错,但还未脱离危险期。

examples.en: Everyone must pull their weight on this project.
examples.zh: 这个项目上人人都得尽自己一份力。

term: put all your eggs in one basket
phonetic: /pʊt ɔːl jɔː(r) eɡz ɪn wʌn ˈbɑːskɪt/

examples.en: Do not put all your eggs in one basket when investing.
examples.zh: 投资时不要把鸡蛋放在一个篮子里。

examples.en: It was raining cats and dogs on the morning of the match.
examples.zh: 比赛当天早晨下起了倾盆大雨。

examples.en: Read between the lines and you will see she is resigning.
examples.zh: 细细体会,你会发现她其实是打算辞职。

examples.en: New hires are often afraid to rock the boat.
examples.zh: 新员工往往不敢打破现状。

examples.en: The two co-founders rarely see eye to eye on strategy.
examples.zh: 两位联合创始人在战略上很少意见一致。

meaning: phr. 保持中立,骑墙观望

examples.en: You cannot sit on the fence forever—choose a side.
examples.zh: 你不能永远骑墙观望——选边站吧。

examples.en: Who spilled the beans about the layoffs?
examples.zh: 裁员的事是谁说出去的?

examples.en: The assistant stole the director's thunder at the press event.
examples.zh: 助理在发布会上抢了导演的风头。

examples.en: Personal ambition must take a back seat during a crisis.
examples.zh: 危机时期,个人抱负必须退居其次。

term: take it with a grain of salt
phonetic: /teɪk ɪt wɪð ə ɡreɪn əv sɔːlt/

examples.en: Take his sales promises with a grain of salt.
examples.zh: 对他的销售承诺要打个折扣听。

meaning: phr. 人人回避的显眼问题

examples.en: Budget cuts are the elephant in the room at every meeting.
examples.zh: 预算削减是每次会上人人回避的话题。

examples.en: The recalled toys are just the tip of the iceberg.
examples.zh: 被召回的玩具只是冰山一角。

examples.en: After three failed launches, the startup threw in the towel.
examples.zh: 三次发布失败后,这家初创公司认输了。

examples.en: Our summer plans are still up in the air.
examples.zh: 我们的暑期计划还没有定下来。

meaning: phr. 小心翼翼,如履薄冰

examples.en: Staff walk on eggshells around the new manager.
examples.zh: 员工在新经理面前说话做事小心翼翼。

meaning: phr. 到关键时刻,事到临头

examples.en: When push comes to shove, family matters more than work.
examples.zh: 真到关键时刻,家庭比工作更重要。

examples.en: The leaked recording only added fuel to the fire.
examples.zh: 外泄的录音只会火上浇油。

meaning: phr. 处在关键时刻,面临抉择

examples.en: The company stands at a crossroads after its founder quit.
examples.zh: 创始人离开后,公司走到了十字路口。

meaning: phr. 承担后果,接受批评

examples.en: He broke the window and now has to face the music.
examples.zh: 他打碎了窗户,现在得承担后果。

examples.en: A useful rule of thumb is one plant pot per diner.
examples.zh: 一条实用的经验法则是每位用餐者配一盆菜。

meaning: v. 消除,使……成为不必要

examples.en: The new bridge obviates the need for ferries.
examples.zh: 新桥使渡轮变得多余。

examples.en: Your current contract precludes outside consulting.
examples.zh: 你现在的合同不允许在外面做咨询。

meaning: v. 预先阻止,先发制人

examples.en: The bank acted quickly to forestall a panic.
examples.zh: 银行迅速行动,抢先阻止了恐慌。

examples.en: The disaster galvanized the town into rebuilding.
examples.zh: 灾难激起全镇投入重建。

examples.en: The fresh funding invigorated the research centre.
examples.zh: 新资金让研究中心焕发活力。

meaning: v. 使恢复活力,使年轻

examples.en: The spa weekend rejuvenated the exhausted nurses.
examples.zh: 温泉周末让疲惫的护士们恢复了元气。

examples.en: Strong exports bolstered the currency this quarter.
examples.zh: 本季度强劲的出口支撑了汇率。

examples.en: Fresh data buttressed the team's hypothesis.
examples.zh: 新数据支持了团队的假设。

examples.en: Trust underpins every good business relationship.
examples.zh: 信任是一切良好商业关系的基石。

meaning: v. 使长久存在,使持续

examples.en: These rules only perpetuate inequality.
examples.zh: 这些规定只会让不平等延续下去。

examples.en: Neither side wanted to protract the negotiations.
examples.zh: 双方都不想拖延谈判。

examples.en: Budget cuts curtailed the outreach programme.
examples.zh: 预算削减使外展项目被压缩。

examples.en: The fire alarm truncated the lecture.
examples.zh: 火警警报使讲座被迫中断。

examples.en: The publisher abridged the novel for younger readers.
examples.zh: 出版社为低龄读者删节了这部小说。

examples.en: The policy engendered widespread resentment.
examples.zh: 这项政策引发了普遍不满。

examples.en: The hit show spawned dozens of imitations.
examples.zh: 这部热播节目催生了数十档模仿之作。

examples.en: He was charged with inciting violence online.
examples.zh: 他被指控在网上煽动暴力。

examples.en: A junior reporter instigated the investigation.
examples.zh: 一名年轻记者发起了这起调查。

examples.en: Rumours fomented unrest in the camps.
examples.zh: 谣言在营地中助长了骚乱。

examples.en: Sense of duty impelled her to speak up.
examples.zh: 责任感促使她站出来说话。

examples.en: Rising demand propelled the stock to a record high.
examples.zh: 旺盛的需求把股价推到了历史新高。

examples.en: Record sales spurred the company to expand.
examples.zh: 创纪录的销售额刺激公司扩张。

examples.en: His rivals goaded him into a careless reply.
examples.zh: 对手的挑衅让他失言回复。

examples.en: Inspectors prodded the utility to fix the pipes.
examples.zh: 检查人员督促公用事业公司修理管道。

examples.en: The scandal hastened the minister's resignation.
examples.zh: 丑闻加快了部长的辞职。

examples.en: Poor drainage retards crop growth here.
examples.zh: 这里排水不畅阻碍了作物生长。

examples.en: Growth decelerated sharply in the third quarter.
examples.zh: 第三季度增长明显放缓。

examples.en: The wind slackened after sunset.
examples.zh: 日落后风势减弱了。

examples.en: Her pulse quickened as the results were read out.
examples.zh: 宣读结果时,她的脉搏加快了。

examples.en: Streaming has supplanted the DVD market almost entirely.
examples.zh: 流媒体几乎完全取代了 DVD 市场。

examples.en: The book rejects the dichotomy between nature and culture.
examples.zh: 这本书否定了自然与文化的二元对立。

examples.en: Smiling staff in the poverty report created an odd incongruity.
examples.zh: 扶贫报告里微笑的工作人员显得极不协调。

examples.en: Economists called the price spike a temporary aberration.
examples.zh: 经济学家称这次价格飙升是暂时反常。

examples.en: By a quirk of fate, both finalists came from the same town.

examples.en: Every shift includes at least one first aider.
examples.zh: 每个班次至少配一名急救员。

examples.en: The loose cable was flagged as a trip hazard.
examples.zh: 松脱的电缆被标记为绊倒隐患。

examples.en: The trip needs a written risk assessment.
examples.zh: 这次出行需要一份书面风险评估。

examples.en: Health and safety rules closed the old stairs.
examples.zh: 出于安全规范,老楼梯被封闭了。

examples.en: Cyclists wore hi-vis jackets in the fog.
examples.zh: 雾中骑行车人都穿上了荧光警示服。

examples.en: Scaffolding wrapped the tower for two years.
examples.zh: 塔楼被脚手架包裹了两年。

examples.en: A hard hat is mandatory beyond this point.
examples.zh: 从此处起必须佩戴安全帽。

examples.en: Roofers clip their safety harness before stepping out.
examples.zh: 屋顶工先扣好安全带再出檐作业。

examples.en: Specialists removed the asbestos ceiling tiles.
examples.zh: 专业人员拆除了含石棉的天花板。

examples.en: The court granted a restraining order on Friday.
examples.zh: 法院周五签发了限制令。

examples.en: A criminal record can bar teaching jobs.
examples.zh: 有犯罪记录可能无法从事教学工作。

examples.en: He completed a community order at the city farm.
examples.zh: 他在城市农场完成了社区服刑令。

examples.en: The judge handed down a suspended sentence.
examples.zh: 法官判处了缓刑。

examples.en: The blogger faced contempt of court charges.
examples.zh: 这名博主面临藐视法庭指控。

meaning: n. 认罪求情协议(辩诉交易)

examples.en: The case ended in a plea bargain.
examples.zh: 案件以辩诉交易告终。

examples.en: The dispute ended with an out-of-court settlement.
examples.zh: 争端以庭外和解收场。

examples.en: The witness faltered under cross-examination.
examples.zh: 证人在交叉质询下乱了方寸。

examples.en: The structural survey flagged subsidence.
examples.zh: 结构鉴定发现了地基沉降问题。

examples.en: A chartered surveyor valued the barn conversion.
examples.zh: 特许测量师为谷仓改造房做了估价。

meaning: n. 房产过户(法律手续)

examples.en: Online conveyancing cut the paperwork in half.
examples.zh: 线上过户流程把文书工作减了一半。

meaning: n. 土地登记局(登记系统)

examples.en: Check the land registry before buying the plot.
examples.zh: 买地前先查土地登记记录。

examples.en: The title deed sits in a bank vault.
examples.zh: 房契存放在银行保险库。

examples.en: First-time buyers escape stamp duty here.
examples.zh: 首次购房者在此免缴印花税。

examples.en: Renting the spare room affects capital gains.
examples.zh: 出租空余房间会影响资本利得税。

examples.en: The farm's value triggers inheritance tax.
examples.zh: 农场的估值触发了遗产税。

examples.en: A tax rebate landed just before the holidays.
examples.zh: 一笔退税恰好在假期前到账。

examples.en: Freelancers file self assessment each January.
examples.zh: 自由职业者每年一月自行报税。

meaning: n. 国民保险(社保缴费)

examples.en: Payslips show income tax and national insurance.
examples.zh: 工资单上列有所得税和国民保险。

examples.en: Her pension pot grew through part-time work.
examples.zh: 她的养老金账户靠兼职工作不断累积。

examples.en: All staff over 22 join the workplace pension.
examples.zh: 所有 22 岁以上员工都加入职场养老金。

meaning: n. 自动加入(养老金)制度

examples.en: Auto-enrolment raised saving rates sharply.
examples.zh: 自动加入制度大幅提高了储蓄率。

examples.en: The annuity pays a fixed sum for life.
examples.zh: 这份年金终身每年支付固定金额。

meaning: n. 房屋净值释放(以房养老)

examples.en: Equity release funded their conservatory.
examples.zh: 他们以房养老释放的资金盖了阳光房。

examples.en: She holds power of attorney for her father.
examples.zh: 她持有父亲的授权委托书。

examples.en: The house cannot be sold until probate finishes.
examples.zh: 遗嘱认证完成前房子不能出售。

examples.en: My sister is executor of the will.
examples.zh: 我姐姐是遗嘱执行人。

examples.en: Name a second beneficiary on the policy.
examples.zh: 保单上请注明第二受益人。

examples.en: Banks require the death certificate to close accounts.
examples.zh: 银行需要死亡证明才能销户。

examples.en: The coroner recorded a verdict of misadventure.
examples.zh: 验尸官作出意外死亡的裁定。

meaning: n. 死因研讯(死因调查)

examples.en: The inquest blamed a wiring fault for the fire.
examples.zh: 死因研讯认定火灾源于电路故障。

examples.en: He chose cremation over burial.
examples.zh: 他选择了火葬而非土葬。

examples.en: The burial took place at sunrise.
examples.zh: 安葬在日出时分举行。

examples.en: The headstone bears a line from her poem.
examples.zh: 墓碑上刻着她诗中的一行。

examples.en: Farm families start estate planning early.
examples.zh: 农场家庭很早就开始遗产规划。

examples.en: The trust fund pays her tuition each term.
examples.zh: 信托基金每学期支付她的学费。

examples.en: The couple signed a prenuptial agreement.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇签署了婚前协议。

examples.en: The settlement included monthly alimony.
examples.zh: 离婚协议包含每月赡养费。

meaning: adj. 一丝不苟的,挑剔的

examples.en: The watchmaker is fastidious about dust.
examples.zh: 这位制表师对灰尘零容忍。

examples.en: The guard gave the bags a perfunctory glance.
examples.zh: 警卫对行李敷衍地扫了一眼。

examples.en: A cursory read missed the key clause.
examples.zh: 粗略一读漏掉了关键条款。

meaning: adj. 专断的,不容置疑的

examples.en: His peremptory tone silenced the room.
examples.zh: 他专断的口吻让满屋安静下来。

examples.en: The brusque receptionist softened by Friday.
examples.zh: 生硬的前台到周五态度缓和了。

meaning: adj. 简慢无礼的,三言两语的

examples.en: Her curt reply ended the thread.
examples.zh: 她简慢的回复终结了整个话题。

examples.en: The captain's terse log records the storm.
examples.zh: 船长简短的航海日志记下了那场风暴。

meaning: adj. 言简意赅的,惜字如金的

examples.en: His laconic "fine" hides exhaustion.
examples.zh: 他惜字如金的一句“还行”藏着疲惫。

examples.en: The prolix preamble buried the argument.
examples.zh: 冗长的开场白埋没了论点。

examples.en: His rambling answer lost the jury.
examples.zh: 他东拉西扯的回答让陪审团云里雾里。

meaning: adj. 尖锐深刻的,一针见血的

examples.en: Her incisive questions exposed the flaw.
examples.zh: 她尖锐的提问暴露了缺陷。

examples.en: The columnist's trenchant critique went viral.
examples.zh: 专栏作家犀利的批评广为流传。

examples.en: An astute investor, she sold before the crash.
examples.zh: 作为精明的投资者,她在崩盘前卖出。

examples.en: The shrewd dealer priced the vase fairly.
examples.zh: 精明的商人给花瓶定了公道价。

meaning: adj. 睿智的,洞察事理的

examples.en: The sagacious coach rested her stars early.
examples.zh: 睿智的教练早早让主力轮休。

examples.en: Judicious edits trimmed the film by an hour.
examples.zh: 明智的剪辑让影片缩短了一小时。

examples.en: A discreet waiter ignored the argument.
examples.zh: 谨慎的服务员假装没听见争执。

meaning: adj. 得体的,机智圆融的

examples.en: Her tactful reply saved the meeting.
examples.zh: 她得体的回答挽救了会议气氛。

examples.en: The amiable guide learned everyone's name.
examples.zh: 和蔼的导游记住了每个人的名字。

examples.en: The two rivals exchanged cordial greetings.
examples.zh: 两位对手热络地互致问候。

meaning: adj. 欢宴的,欢乐友好的

examples.en: The course ended in a convivial dinner.
examples.zh: 课程在一场欢宴中落幕。

examples.en: The jovial innkeeper poured tea for everyone.
examples.zh: 爽朗的客栈老板给每个人斟茶。

meaning: adj. 肯配合的;可接受的

examples.en: The council proved amenable to the compromise.
examples.zh: 市政会表示愿意接受折中方案。

examples.en: The factory is fully compliant with the new rules.
examples.zh: 工厂完全符合新规。

examples.en: The once wild pony is now docile.
examples.zh: 曾经狂野的小马如今很温顺。

meaning: adj. 谄媚的,卑躬屈膝的

examples.en: The obsequious clerk flattered every customer.
examples.zh: 谄媚的店员逢人便奉承。

examples.en: His servile manner irritated the judges.
examples.zh: 他卑躬屈膝的样子惹恼了评委。

examples.en: The fawning profile ignored her failures.
examples.zh: 那篇奉承的专访对她的失误只字未提。

meaning: adj. 谄媚的,马屁精式的

examples.en: The CEO purged his sycophantic inner circle.
examples.zh: 首席执行官清退了身边的马屁精圈子。

examples.en: She answered the panel with perfect poise.
examples.zh: 她从容不迫地回答了评审团的提问。

examples.en: The elated winners danced on the pitch.
examples.zh: 兴高采烈的获胜者在球场上跳起舞来。

examples.en: Jubilant fans flooded the town square.
examples.zh: 欢腾的球迷涌向市政广场。

examples.en: The dejected runner thanked her coach anyway.
examples.zh: 沮丧的选手还是感谢了教练。

examples.en: After three rejections, he grew despondent.
examples.zh: 三度被拒后,他渐渐消沉。

meaning: adj. 孤苦凄凉的;渺茫的

examples.en: A forlorn bicycle rusted at the station.
examples.zh: 一辆无人认领的自行车在车站生锈。

examples.en: The crestfallen apprentice burnt the soup again.
examples.zh: 沮丧的学徒又把汤烧糊了。

meaning: adj. 阴郁的,闷闷不乐的

examples.en: The morose goalkeeper skipped the celebration.
examples.zh: 阴郁的门将没有参加庆祝。

meaning: adj. 愠怒的,郁郁寡欢的

examples.en: The teenager gave a sullen shrug.
examples.zh: 少年愠怒地耸了耸肩。

examples.en: A surly border guard checked each passport twice.
examples.zh: 一个乖戾的边检员把每本护照查了两遍。

examples.en: His petulant outburst cost him the lead role.
examples.zh: 他任性发脾气丢了主角。

examples.en: Lack of sleep made the pilot peevish.
examples.zh: 缺觉让飞行员变得易怒。

examples.en: The irascible chef yelled at the supplier.
examples.zh: 暴躁的主厨冲供应商大吼。

examples.en: The lake was serene at first light.
examples.zh: 晨光初现时湖面宁静安详。

examples.en: They rented a tranquil cottage above the bay.
examples.zh: 他们在海湾上方租了一栋安静的小屋。

meaning: adj. 惆怅的,留恋向往的

examples.en: She threw a wistful glance at the old piano.
examples.zh: 她惆怅地望了一眼那架旧钢琴。

examples.en: The pensive inspector stared at the map.
examples.zh: 沉思的督察盯着地图出神。

examples.en: The film's melancholic score lingers for days.
examples.zh: 影片忧郁的配乐余音绕梁。

meaning: adj. 乐观高涨的;有浮力的

examples.en: The team is buoyant after three wins.
examples.zh: 三连胜后全队士气高涨。

examples.en: Her ebullient welcome put guests at ease.
examples.zh: 她热情洋溢的欢迎让宾至如归。

meaning: adj. 热情奔放的,生机勃勃的

examples.en: Exuberant children greeted the firefighters.
examples.zh: 孩子们兴高采烈地迎接消防员。

meaning: adj. 垂头丧气的,低垂的

examples.en: The witnesses left court looking downcast.
examples.zh: 证人离开法庭时神色黯然。

examples.en: A dispirited crew finished the harvest anyway.
examples.zh: 气馁的农工们还是收完了庄稼。

examples.en: Repeated defeats left the squad demoralized.
examples.zh: 连败让全队士气低落。

examples.en: The beach felt desolate in November.
examples.zh: 十一月的海滩荒凉冷清。

examples.en: The anguished parents waited outside theatre.
examples.zh: 悲痛万分的父母在手术室外等候。

meaning: adj. 心烦意乱的,忧心如焚的

examples.en: Distraught neighbours searched the woods all night.
examples.zh: 心急如焚的邻居们彻夜搜索树林。

examples.en: The agitated passenger paced the platform.
examples.zh: 焦躁的乘客在站台上踱来踱去。

examples.en: Bewildered tourists stared at the closed sign.
examples.zh: 一头雾水的游客盯着停业告示。

examples.en: The judge looked perplexed by the answer.
examples.zh: 法官对这个回答面露困惑。

meaning: adj. 震惊的,大吃一惊的

examples.en: Astounded locals watched the whale in the marina.
examples.zh: 当地居民惊愕地看着游艇码头里的鲸鱼。

examples.en: The delay could conceivably stretch into March.
examples.zh: 延误有可能拖到三月。

examples.en: The trip was ostensibly for research.
examples.zh: 这趟旅行名义上是为了调研。

examples.en: The footage purportedly shows the crash site.
examples.zh: 这段影像据称拍摄于坠机地点。

examples.en: The manager allegedly ignored the warnings.
examples.zh: 据称这位经理无视了警告。

examples.en: The deal is reportedly worth 40 million.
examples.zh: 据报道这笔交易价值四千万。

examples.en: She will doubtless reply by morning.
examples.zh: 想必她天亮前就会回复。

examples.en: The verdict was indisputably correct.
examples.zh: 这一判罚毫无疑问是正确的。

examples.en: The excuse was patently absurd.
examples.zh: 这个借口显然荒谬。

examples.en: The scheme is manifestly underfunded.
examples.zh: 该计划显然资金不足。

examples.en: The bridge opened, weather notwithstanding.
examples.zh: 尽管天气不佳,大桥还是通车了。

examples.en: A useful map, albeit an outdated one.
examples.zh: 这是一张有用的地图,尽管已过时。

examples.en: The claim was tested empirically.
examples.zh: 这一说法经过了实证检验。

meaning: adv. 从性质上,定性地区别

examples.en: The new engine is qualitatively quieter.
examples.zh: 新发动机在安静程度上有质的差别。

examples.en: The ferry is invariably late on Sundays.
examples.zh: 这班渡轮周日准点率总是很低。

examples.en: Rising costs inevitably hit fares.
examples.zh: 成本上涨不可避免地推高票价。

meaning: adv. 可预料地,不出所料地

examples.en: Predictably, the strike ended in compromise.
examples.zh: 不出所料,罢工以妥协收场。

examples.en: Understandably, residents want answers tonight.
examples.zh: 居民们想要说法,这可以理解。

meaning: adv. 非凡地,引人注目地

examples.en: The cabin is remarkably quiet at speed.
examples.zh: 这间客舱高速行驶时出奇地安静。

examples.en: The twins are strikingly different in temperament.
examples.zh: 这对双胞胎性情迥异。

examples.en: Attendance rose markedly after the reform.
examples.zh: 改革后出席率显著上升。

examples.en: The noise dropped appreciably with new windows.
examples.zh: 换了新窗后噪音明显下降。

examples.en: Growth was marginally better than forecast.
examples.zh: 增速略好于预期。

examples.en: The village is predominantly agricultural.
examples.zh: 这个村子以农业为主。

examples.en: Shareholders voted overwhelmingly for the merger.
examples.zh: 股东压倒性地投票支持合并。

examples.en: The lab unequivocally denied the allegations.
examples.zh: 实验室毫不含糊地否认了指控。

examples.en: He categorically denied the leak.
examples.zh: 他断然否认泄露一事。

examples.en: She flatly refused to reopen the case.
examples.zh: 她断然拒绝重审此案。

examples.en: We've tentatively booked the hall for June.
examples.zh: 我们暂定订下六月的礼堂。

examples.en: The route is provisionally set for spring.
examples.zh: 路线暂定春季开通。

examples.en: The editor inadvertently deleted the appendix.
examples.zh: 编辑一不小心删掉了附录。

meaning: phr. 肆虐,造成严重破坏

examples.en: The storm wreaked havoc on coastal farms.
examples.zh: 风暴让沿海农场损失惨重。

meaning: phr. 自然发展完毕(听其自然)

examples.en: The fever was left to run its course.
examples.zh: 这次发烧顺其自然地过去了。

examples.en: Old habits still hold sway in the workshop.
examples.zh: 老习惯仍在车间里占上风。

examples.en: Expert reviews carry weight with buyers.
examples.zh: 专家评测对买家很有分量。

meaning: phr. 使更可信,为……提供佐证

examples.en: The photos lend credence to the report.
examples.zh: 这些照片为报道提供了佐证。

examples.en: Both sides were urged to exercise restraint.
examples.zh: 双方被敦促保持克制。

examples.en: The logo redesign drew fierce criticism.
examples.zh: 标识改版招致猛烈批评。

examples.en: The bonus scheme sparked public outrage.
examples.zh: 奖金方案引发了公愤。

examples.en: Rumours of shortages stoked fears online.
examples.zh: 短缺的谣言在网上加剧了恐慌。

examples.en: The mayor sought to allay fears over parking.
examples.zh: 市长试图消除关于停车的担忧。

meaning: phr. 令人侧目,引人惊讶

examples.en: His casual outfit raised eyebrows at court.
examples.zh: 他随意的穿着在法庭上引人侧目。

meaning: phr. 睁一只眼闭一只眼

examples.en: Inspectors turned a blind eye to minor faults.
examples.zh: 检查员对小瑕疵睁一只眼闭一只眼。

examples.en: A late goal turned the tide of the final.
examples.zh: 终场前的一记进球扭转了决赛局势。

examples.en: Nothing seemed to stem the tide of closures.
examples.zh: 似乎没有什么能遏制关店潮。

examples.en: The café weathered the storm of roadworks.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆熬过了修路的艰难期。

meaning: phr. 播下(祸根/希望的)种子

examples.en: The scheme sowed the seeds of recovery.
examples.zh: 该计划播下了复苏的种子。

examples.en: Savers reaped the rewards of patience.
examples.zh: 储户收获了耐心的回报。

examples.en: One workshop will not move the needle on safety.
examples.zh: 一次研讨会不会给安全带来实质改变。

meaning: phr. 创造奇迹,竭尽全力

examples.en: Volunteers moved mountains before the festival.
examples.zh: 志愿者们在节前拼尽了全力。

examples.en: Faster broadband can widen the education gap.
examples.zh: 更快的宽带也可能拉大教育差距。

examples.en: Mentoring helped close the attainment gap.
examples.zh: 导师制帮助缩小了成绩差距。

examples.en: Sponsored posts blur the line between news and ads.
examples.zh: 赞助内容模糊了新闻与广告的界限。

examples.en: New MPs quickly learn to toe the line.
examples.zh: 新议员很快学会按党的路线行事。

examples.en: The inquiry is drawing to a close.
examples.zh: 调查接近尾声。

examples.en: The city ground to a halt in the snow.
examples.zh: 一场雪让全城渐渐陷入停摆。

examples.en: New evidence came to light last week.
examples.zh: 新证据上周曝光。

examples.en: The ad cast aspersions on rival products.
examples.zh: 这则广告含沙射影地贬损竞品。

examples.en: Parents voiced concerns about class sizes.
examples.zh: 家长们对班级规模表达了担忧。

examples.en: The forum lets tenants air grievances safely.
examples.zh: 论坛让租户得以安全地倾诉不满。

examples.en: The shop chose not to press charges.
examples.zh: 店家选择不予追究。

meaning: phr. 自食其果,种瓜得瓜

examples.en: Cut corners now and you will reap what you sow.
examples.zh: 现在偷工减料,将来必自食其果。

examples.en: The audit brought the double billing to light.
examples.zh: 审计揭穿了重复收费问题。

examples.en: Unions levelled criticism at the pay freeze.
examples.zh: 工会对工资冻结提出批评。

examples.en: Prosecutors dropped the charges for lack of proof.
examples.zh: 因证据不足,检方撤销了指控。

examples.en: The tiny club beat the odds to reach the final.
examples.zh: 这家小球会爆冷闯进决赛。

examples.en: The orchard defied the odds after the frost.
examples.zh: 果园在霜冻后奇迹般恢复。

examples.en: One late goal tipped the balance.
examples.zh: 一记绝杀决定了胜负。

examples.en: Postal votes swung the balance in the recount.
examples.zh: 邮寄选票在重新计票中扭转了局势。

examples.en: Quotas redress the balance in boardrooms.
examples.zh: 配额制矫正了董事会的失衡。

examples.en: Police restored order within an hour.
examples.zh: 警方一小时内恢复了秩序。

meaning: phr. 维持治安;避免争吵

examples.en: Neighbours take turns keeping the peace at matches.
examples.zh: 邻居们轮流在比赛日维持秩序。

examples.en: He was fined for disturbing the peace.
examples.zh: 他因扰乱治安被罚款。

examples.en: The project hung in the balance for weeks.
examples.zh: 项目悬了几周才定下来。

examples.en: The advert struck a chord with commuters.
examples.zh: 这则广告戳中了通勤族的心。

examples.en: The menu strikes a balance between cost and flair.
examples.zh: 菜单在成本与创意之间取得平衡。

examples.en: Warming waters pose a threat to cod stocks.
examples.zh: 海水升温对鳕鱼种群构成威胁。

examples.en: Hills pose a challenge for wheelchair users.
examples.zh: 坡道给轮椅使用者带来挑战。

meaning: phr. 如期完成,赶上截止

examples.en: The crew met every printing deadline.
examples.zh: 团队每次都赶上了印制截止期。

examples.en: Missing one deadline triggers a penalty clause.
examples.zh: 错过一次截止期即触发违约条款。

examples.en: The bakery struggles to meet weekend demand.
examples.zh: 面包店周末供不应求。

examples.en: The refurbished hotel exceeded all expectations.
examples.zh: 翻新后的酒店远超预期。

meaning: phr. 管理预期(避免失望)

examples.en: Good doctors manage expectations honestly.
examples.zh: 好医生会坦诚地管理病人预期。

meaning: phr. 设定议程;主导话题

examples.en: The scandal set the agenda for a month.
examples.zh: 这桩丑闻主导了一个月的舆论议程。

examples.en: Housing now dominates the council's agenda.
examples.zh: 住房问题如今主导着市政议程。

examples.en: Protesters were accused of hijacking the agenda.
examples.zh: 抗议者被指责劫持了会议议题。

examples.en: The strike brought production to a halt.
examples.zh: 罢工让生产全面停摆。

examples.en: The redesign met with universal approval.
examples.zh: 改版设计获得一致认可。

examples.en: The levy met fierce resistance from retailers.
examples.zh: 这项征税遭到零售商的顽强抵制。

examples.en: The shelter meets a real local need.
examples.zh: 这处收容所满足了当地的切实需要。

examples.en: The community café filled a void after the pub shut.
examples.zh: 社区咖啡馆填补了酒馆关门后的空缺。

meaning: phr. 挖到金矿;取得重大成功

examples.en: The podcast struck gold with true crime.
examples.zh: 这档播客靠真实罪案题材一炮而红。

examples.en: The cartoon hit a nerve in the industry.
examples.zh: 这幅漫画戳中了行业的痛处。

examples.en: Her speech touched a nerve with parents.
examples.zh: 她的演讲触动了家长们的心。

meaning: phr. 切身体会到,触动内心

examples.en: The scale of the flood hit home on the tour.
examples.zh: 亲眼所见才让人真正体会到洪灾之重。

meaning: phr. 依法惩处,追究责任

examples.en: Regulators finally brought the firm to book.
examples.zh: 监管机构最终追究了这家公司的责任。

examples.en: Judges threw the book at the repeat offenders.
examples.zh: 法官对惯犯从严判罚。

examples.en: The coach read the team the riot act at halftime.
examples.zh: 中场休息时教练把队员狠狠训了一顿。

examples.en: MPs took the minister to task over the delay.
examples.zh: 议员们就延误问题问责部长。

meaning: phr. 要求作出解释,问责

examples.en: The board called the CEO to account.
examples.zh: 董事会要求首席执行官作出解释。

examples.en: The regulator brought the utilities to heel.
examples.zh: 监管机构让公用事业公司乖乖就范。

examples.en: Rangers keep deer numbers in check.
examples.zh: 护林员控制着鹿群数量。

examples.en: The committee tried to rein in spending.
examples.zh: 委员会试图收紧开支。

examples.en: The city vowed to crack down on street racing.
examples.zh: 该市誓言整治街头飙车。

examples.en: The airline cleaned up its act after the fines.
examples.zh: 挨罚之后,这家航空公司整改了作风。

meaning: phr. 翻开新的一页,重新做人

examples.en: He turned over a new leaf after prison.
examples.zh: 出狱后他洗心革面。

examples.en: The label made amends with a public apology.
examples.zh: 厂牌以公开道歉作出弥补。

examples.en: She spent years atoning for the error.
examples.zh: 她用多年弥补那个错误。

meaning: phr. 带来红利,产生长远好处

examples.en: Early practice pays dividends in exams.
examples.zh: 早期训练会在考试中带来回报。

examples.en: The scholarship scheme reaped a rich harvest.
examples.zh: 奖学金计划结出累累硕果。

examples.en: Coastal towns bore the brunt of the storm.
examples.zh: 沿海城镇在风暴中首当其冲。

meaning: phr. 挨炮轰,受猛烈批评

examples.en: The referee took the flak for the disallowed goal.
examples.zh: 裁判因进球无效而饱受抨击。

examples.en: The captain took the heat for the loss.
examples.zh: 队长为失利扛下了所有指责。

examples.en: Departments passed the buck for a month.
examples.zh: 各部门互相踢了一个月皮球。

examples.en: The coach shouldered the blame for the defeat.
examples.zh: 教练为失利承担了责任。

examples.en: The report apportioned blame to both crews.
examples.zh: 报告认定两个机组均有责任。

examples.en: Logs absolved the driver of blame.
examples.zh: 行车记录还了司机清白。

examples.en: The scientist fought for years to clear her name.
examples.zh: 这位科学家奋战多年为自己正名。

examples.en: The force pledged to rebuild trust locally.
examples.zh: 该警队承诺重建当地信任。

examples.en: Secret fees erode trust in brokers.
examples.zh: 隐性收费侵蚀着对经纪人的信任。

examples.en: The programme won hearts and minds in weeks.
examples.zh: 该项目数周内便赢得民心。

meaning: adj. 朴素的,简朴的;严峻的

examples.en: The monk's cell was austere but warm.
examples.zh: 僧房陈设简朴却很暖和。

examples.en: The hostel rooms are spartan yet spotless.
examples.zh: 旅舍房间陈设简单却一尘不染。

examples.en: The hotel lobby is all marble and opulent gold.
examples.zh: 酒店大堂满是大理石与奢华金饰。

examples.en: The couple threw a lavish reception for 400 guests.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇办了一场四百人的豪华婚宴。

examples.en: He wore an ostentatious gold watch to the interview.
examples.zh: 他戴着一块招摇的金表去面试。

examples.en: The film's extravagant sets drained the budget.
examples.zh: 影片奢华的布景耗尽了预算。

meaning: adj. 张扬炫目的,艳丽的

examples.en: The flamboyant presenter wore a sequined suit.
examples.zh: 这位张扬的主持人穿了一身亮片西装。

examples.en: Garish neon signs line the strip at night.
examples.zh: 夜里,俗艳的霓虹招牌沿街连成一片。

examples.en: The tree drooped with gaudy plastic ornaments.
examples.zh: 圣诞树挂满了俗气的塑料饰品。

meaning: n./adj. 庸俗工艺品(的),媚俗(的)

examples.en: The café embraces retro kitsch on every shelf.
examples.zh: 这家咖啡馆每个架子上都是复古媚俗小物。

examples.en: Her understated elegance won the critics over.
examples.zh: 她低调的优雅征服了评论界。

examples.en: The unassuming bistro holds a Michelin star.
examples.zh: 这家不起眼的小餐馆握有一颗米其林星。

meaning: adj. 不装腔作势的,朴实无华的

examples.en: An unpretentious guide to wine lists.
examples.zh: 一本朴实无华的点酒指南。

meaning: adj. 做作的,自命不凡的

examples.en: The review called the menu pretentious.
examples.zh: 剧评称这份菜单故作高深。

examples.en: He prefers substance to showy gestures.
examples.zh: 比起花架子,他更重实效。

examples.en: The dealership's flashy TV ads annoy locals.
examples.zh: 车商浮夸的电视广告惹恼了当地人。

meaning: adj. 乏味的,平淡无奇的

examples.en: The script was insipid despite the star cast.
examples.zh: 尽管阵容豪华,剧本依然寡淡无味。

meaning: adj. 索然无味的,无生气的

examples.en: Vapid small talk fills the first hour.
examples.zh: 头一个小时全是空洞的寒暄。

examples.en: The plot collapses into banal clichés.
examples.zh: 剧情沦为陈腐的俗套。

examples.en: The hackneyed ending spoils a promising film.
examples.zh: 老套的结局糟蹋了一部有前途的片子。

examples.en: The dialogue is cliched but heartfelt.
examples.zh: 对白虽俗套却情真意切。

meaning: adj. 老生常谈的,陈腐的

examples.en: The motto feels trite until you live it.
examples.zh: 这句座右铭不践行就显得空洞。

meaning: adj. 平淡乏味的;散文的

examples.en: The truth behind the legend is prosaic.
examples.zh: 传说背后的真相平淡无奇。

examples.en: He escaped mundane routines by sailing.
examples.zh: 他靠航海逃离柴米油盐的日常。

examples.en: A humdrum suburb hides a vibrant music scene.
examples.zh: 单调的郊区藏着火热的音乐圈。

examples.en: The referee missed a run-of-the-mill foul.
examples.zh: 裁判漏判了一次再普通不过的犯规。

examples.en: It was a garden-variety cold, not flu.
examples.zh: 这只是普通感冒,不是流感。

examples.en: Smartphones are ubiquitous even on remote trails.
examples.zh: 即使在偏远步道,智能手机也无处不在。

meaning: adj. 弥漫的,无处不在的

examples.en: A pervasive smell of hops filled the street.
examples.zh: 整条街弥漫着啤酒花的气味。

examples.en: Seagulls are omnipresent along the pier.
examples.zh: 码头上海鸥无孔不入。

examples.en: Smuggling was rife along the border.
examples.zh: 边境一带走私猖獗。

examples.en: The strike won widespread public support.
examples.zh: 罢工赢得了广泛的公众支持。

examples.en: Myopia is prevalent among school leavers.
examples.zh: 近视在毕业生中相当普遍。

examples.en: Sporadic clashes continued after curfew.
examples.zh: 宵禁后零星冲突仍在继续。

meaning: adj. 间歇的,断断续续的

examples.en: Intermittent rain delayed the cricket twice.
examples.zh: 断断续续的雨两度中断了比赛。

examples.en: The pain is episodic rather than constant.
examples.zh: 疼痛时有时无,并非持续不断。

meaning: adj. 长期存在的,反复出现的

examples.en: Parking is a perennial council headache.
examples.zh: 停车问题常年困扰着市政会。

meaning: n. 反传统者,偶像破坏者

examples.en: The director is a proud iconoclast.
examples.zh: 这位导演是个自豪的离经叛道者。

examples.en: Dissidents printed leaflets in secret.
examples.zh: 异见人士秘密印刷传单。

examples.en: The renegade cop exposed the cover-up.
examples.zh: 这名倒戈的警察揭开了掩盖真相的盖子。

examples.en: Her nonconformist style shaped the brand.
examples.zh: 她特立独行的风格塑造了这个品牌。

examples.en: Every board needs a contrarian.
examples.zh: 每个董事会都需要一个唱反调的人。

examples.en: A self-confessed hedonist, he sails every weekend.
examples.zh: 他自称享乐主义者,每个周末都去航海。

examples.en: The novelist became a recluse after 1998.
examples.zh: 这位小说家 1998 年后深居简出。

examples.en: A hermit kept the lighthouse for forty years.
examples.zh: 一位隐居者看守灯塔四十年。

examples.en: The gala drew socialites and filmmakers.
examples.zh: 晚宴云集了名流与电影人。

meaning: n. 浅尝辄止的业余爱好者

examples.en: Critics dismissed him as a dilettante.
examples.zh: 批评者斥他为半吊子玩家。

examples.en: The doyen of food critics retired at 80.
examples.zh: 美食评论界的泰斗八十岁退休。

examples.en: The doyenne of potters still teaches Saturdays.
examples.zh: 陶艺界的老前辈仍每周六授课。

examples.en: The clinic is an exemplar of patient care.
examples.zh: 这家诊所是患者护理的典范。

examples.en: The soprano became the orchestra's standard-bearer.
examples.zh: 这位女高音成了乐团的旗帜。

meaning: n. 傀儡首领,挂名领导

examples.en: The president remained a mere figurehead.
examples.zh: 会长始终只是个挂名的领袖。

examples.en: The tower became the poster child for bad planning.
examples.zh: 这座塔成了规划失败的活标本。

meaning: n. 火炬手;事业传承者

examples.en: She saw herself as a torchbearer for women in sport.
examples.zh: 她视自己为女子体育的火炬手。

examples.en: The nurse was a trailblazer in hospice care.
examples.zh: 这位护士是临终关怀的先驱。

examples.en: Cheap batteries were the game-changer for scooters.
examples.zh: 廉价电池成了滑板车行业的格局改变者。

examples.en: The disruptor now faces its own challengers.
examples.zh: 这位颠覆者如今也迎来了挑战者。

examples.en: Every gallery opening draws the city's movers and shakers.
examples.zh: 每场画廊开幕都聚齐了城中名流。

meaning: n. 强者,实力雄厚的机构

examples.en: The college is a powerhouse in robotics.
examples.zh: 这所学院是机器人领域的重镇。

meaning: n. 精力充沛的人;发电机

examples.en: The new curator is a real dynamo.
examples.zh: 新馆长浑身是劲。

examples.en: The discovery was pure happenstance.
examples.zh: 这一发现纯属机缘巧合。

meaning: n. 意外发现美好事物的运气

examples.en: Their meeting was a case of serendipity.
examples.zh: 他们的相遇是一桩美丽的意外。

examples.en: By coincidence, both winners drew the same number.
examples.zh: 巧的是,两位中奖者抽中了同一号码。

examples.en: Winners were picked at random by computer.
examples.zh: 获奖者由电脑随机抽选。

examples.en: She mentioned the merger only in passing.
examples.zh: 她只是顺带提了一下合并的事。

meaning: phr. 即兴地,未加准备地

examples.en: He answered the tribute off the cuff.
examples.zh: 他即席回应了那段致谢。

meaning: phr. 边进行边(临时处理)

examples.en: The crew fixed the schedule on the fly.
examples.zh: 机组人员临时调整了时刻表。

term: on the spur of the moment
meaning: phr. 一时兴起,心血来潮

examples.en: They booked the ferry on the spur of the moment.
examples.zh: 他们一时兴起订了船票。

examples.en: The train leaves at seven on the dot.
examples.zh: 火车七点整准时发车。

meaning: phr. 正是时候,千钧一发之际

examples.en: The keeper arrived in the nick of time.
examples.zh: 守门员在千钧一发之际赶到。

examples.en: The deal was saved at the eleventh hour.
examples.zh: 交易在最后关头起死回生。

examples.en: Every so often the lighthouse still guides a boat home.
examples.zh: 灯塔时不时还能为一艘船指引归途。

examples.en: Refunds will arrive in due course.
examples.zh: 退款会在适当时候到账。

examples.en: The roof needs fixing sooner rather than later.
examples.zh: 屋顶要尽早修,不能再拖。

examples.en: Rents will rise in the short term.
examples.zh: 短期内租金会上涨。

examples.en: The bridge is closed for the time being.
examples.zh: 大桥目前暂时封闭。

examples.en: The jury deliberated at length before acquitting.
examples.zh: 陪审团反复商议许久,最终裁定无罪。

meaning: phr. 在逃的;整体的,全体的

examples.en: The suspect remains at large this morning.
examples.zh: 嫌疑人今晨仍在逃。

examples.en: By and large, commuters welcomed the new timetable.
examples.zh: 总体而言,通勤者欢迎新时刻表。

examples.en: The crowd, in the main, stayed cheerful.
examples.zh: 人群基本上情绪高涨。

meaning: phr. 多半,在大多数情况下

examples.en: The route, for the most part, follows the river.
examples.zh: 这条路大部分路段沿河而行。

examples.en: Success depends to a large extent on sleep.
examples.zh: 成功在很大程度上取决于睡眠。

examples.en: The coach told them in no uncertain terms to sharpen up.
examples.zh: 教练直截了当地要求他们打起精神。

examples.en: In broad terms, costs fell by a tenth.
examples.zh: 概括地说,成本下降了十分之一。

examples.en: In practical terms, the grant buys two vans.
examples.zh: 实际而言,这笔拨款能买两辆货车。

meaning: phr. 扣除物价因素,按实际价值

examples.en: Wages fell in real terms last year.
examples.zh: 去年实际工资下降了。

examples.en: On paper, the hostel sleeps thirty.
examples.zh: 理论上这家旅舍能睡三十人。

examples.en: The board agreed in principle to the sale.
examples.zh: 董事会原则上同意出售。

examples.en: The veto is, in effect, a final say.
examples.zh: 否决权实际上就是最终决定权。

examples.en: All told, the repairs took nine weeks.
examples.zh: 修理前后总共花了九周。

term: when all is said and done

examples.en: When all is said and done, the fans decide.
examples.zh: 归根结底,还是球迷说了算。

meaning: phr. 一劳永逸地,彻底地

examples.en: Let's settle the boundary once and for all.
examples.zh: 咱们把边界问题一劳永逸地解决掉。

examples.en: It was now or never for the summit push.
examples.zh: 冲顶就看这一次了。

examples.en: The mayor answered the challenge here and now.
examples.zh: 市长当场回应了这一质疑。

examples.en: Collectors came from far and wide.
examples.zh: 藏家们从四面八方赶来。

examples.en: First and foremost, the bridge must be safe.
examples.zh: 首要的是,这座桥必须安全。

examples.en: The climbers returned safe and sound.
examples.zh: 登山者们安然无恙地归来。

meaning: phr. 同甘共苦,不离不弃

examples.en: She supported the club through thick and thin.
examples.zh: 她与俱乐部同甘共苦,不离不弃。

meaning: phr. 想方设法(不择手段)

examples.en: They vowed to win by hook or by crook.
examples.zh: 他们发誓无论如何也要赢。

examples.en: The market opens at dawn, come rain or shine.
examples.zh: 无论晴雨,集市黎明开张。

meaning: phr. 无论好坏,不管怎样

examples.en: For better or worse, the decision is final.
examples.zh: 无论好坏,这个决定已无法更改。

meaning: phr. 无论如何,总能想办法

examples.en: One way or another, the show will go on.
examples.zh: 无论如何,演出都会继续。

examples.en: He clung to the title by fair means or foul.
examples.zh: 他靠各种手段保住了头衔。

meaning: phr. 即便如此,尽管这样

examples.en: Be that as it may, the deadline stands.
examples.zh: 即便如此,截止日期不变。

examples.en: The parts arrived—at any rate, most of them.
examples.zh: 零件到了——至少大部分到了。

examples.en: Come what may, the bakery opens at six.
examples.zh: 无论发生什么,面包店六点开门。

meaning: phr. 绝不,任何情况下都不

examples.en: Under no circumstances open the door to strangers.
examples.zh: 任何情况下都不要给陌生人开门。

examples.en: On no account should the seal be broken before sale.
examples.zh: 售出前严禁拆封。

meaning: phr. 无须多说,只说一句足矣

examples.en: Suffice it to say, the wedding was memorable.
examples.zh: 无须多言,那场婚礼令人难忘。

examples.en: When the chips are down, neighbours help.
examples.zh: 危急关头,邻里总会伸出援手。

examples.en: On reflection, she withdrew the complaint.
examples.zh: 再三考虑后,她撤回了投诉。

examples.en: In retrospect, the warning signs were clear.
examples.zh: 现在回头看,预警信号其实很明显。

examples.en: All things considered, it was a fair price.
examples.zh: 通盘考虑,这个价格还算公道。

examples.en: By comparison, the old route took twice as long.
examples.zh: 相比之下,旧路线耗时翻倍。

examples.en: He isn't lazy—quite the contrary.
examples.zh: 他并不懒——恰恰相反。

examples.en: The boat seats six—or rather, squeezes six.
examples.zh: 这条船坐得下六个人——更准确说,是挤得下。

examples.en: Put simply, demand outstripped supply.
examples.zh: 简单说,供不应求。

examples.en: A romantic at heart, he hides it well.

examples.en: The anticyclone promises a settled week.
examples.zh: 这个反气旋将带来一周稳定天气。

examples.en: Wind chill drops the feel to minus five.
examples.zh: 风寒效应使体感温度降至零下五度。

examples.en: A sudden cloudburst flooded the underpass.
examples.zh: 一场骤雨淹没了地下通道。

examples.en: Runners sheltered from the downpour.
examples.zh: 跑步者在倾盆大雨中躲避。

examples.en: Sleet turned to snow after dark.
examples.zh: 天黑后雨夹雪转为降雪。

examples.en: Hailstones drummed on the conservatory roof.
examples.zh: 冰雹砸得温室屋顶咚咚作响。

examples.en: A flurry of snow dusted the moor.
examples.zh: 一阵小雪给荒原覆上薄白。

examples.en: Drivers abandoned cars in the whiteout.
examples.zh: 司机们在一片白茫中弃车步行。

examples.en: Patches of fog cling to the valley floor.
examples.zh: 雾气片片笼罩着谷底。

examples.en: Sea mist rolled in before dawn.
examples.zh: 海雾在黎明前涌上岸来。

examples.en: The haar can linger all morning.
examples.zh: 这种湿海雾能盘桓整个上午。

examples.en: The windward slope catches the rain.
examples.zh: 迎风坡截住大部分降水。

examples.en: Boats anchor on the leeward side.
examples.zh: 船只停泊在背风一侧。

examples.en: A fierce headwind slowed the commuters.
examples.zh: 强劲的逆风拖慢了通勤者。

examples.en: A tailwind pushed the flight early.
examples.zh: 顺风让航班提前抵达。

examples.en: Crosswinds tested the ferry crossing.
examples.zh: 侧风考验着渡轮航行。

examples.en: Gales toppled scaffolding overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜狂风吹倒了脚手架。

examples.en: A snow squall whitened the ridge.
examples.zh: 一阵短时风雪让山脊白茫茫。

examples.en: An amber weather warning covers the north.
examples.zh: 北部发布橙色天气预警。

examples.en: The met office issued an amber alert.
examples.zh: 气象局发布了橙色预警。

examples.en: The first named storm arrives in October.
examples.zh: 首个具名风暴将于十月来袭。

examples.en: The barometer is falling fast.
examples.zh: 气压计读数急落。

examples.en: Tight isobars mean strengthening winds.
examples.zh: 等压线密集意味着风力渐强。

examples.en: A spell of settled weather helps harvest.
examples.zh: 一段稳定天气有助收割。

examples.en: April is notoriously changeable.
examples.zh: 四月的天气以多变著称。

examples.en: An overcast sky kept temperatures low.
examples.zh: 阴云密布使气温保持低位。

examples.en: A clear spell graced the afternoon.
examples.zh: 午后短暂放晴。

examples.en: Freak weather tore roofs from barns.
examples.zh: 反常天气掀翻了谷仓顶。

examples.en: The heat index tops forty by noon.
examples.zh: 正午炎热指数突破四十。

examples.en: Unseasonable mildness confused the bulbs.
examples.zh: 不合时令的温暖让球茎植物提前萌发。
